“Sister is so beautiful and alluring, If only you were mine, sob sob sob.”
“Sister your hands can touch games, but why won’t you touch me?”
Jiang Zi cornered her at the computer desk, her white jade-like skin flashing momentarily under the lens. One delicate hand wrapped possessively around her slender waist, while she turned off the computer with a deft motion… From beginning to end, the person she loved had never changed.
associated_names: 穿成恶毒女配？我攻略女主！
穿成惡毒女配？我攻略女主！

89500.synopsis:
At the age of 9, Mia remembered her previous life and made a proposal to her indifferent fiancé: “If you find someone you love, I’ll break off the engagement right away. So, until then, why don’t we be friends?”
This is a slightly mismatched love story between Mia, who remembers her past life, and Raphael, who was deprived of a loving family.
associated_names: 転生令嬢が大団円を目指したら

90524.synopsis:
Oh, come on, you’re kidding me.”
One day, I woke up and when I looked in the mirror, I saw that I had been reincarnated as Grace, the villainous third son of a ducal family in the game “Brace of Worlds”.
Fortunately, “Brace of Worlds” was a game I had played prior to my reincarnation.
I immediately checked my stats to see what skills I had been given.
I saw that I had a super low probability divine skill set, a combination of copying skills and skill fusion!
I did it!　With this divine skill set, I should be able to avoid execution end and progress through the game world with a considerable advantage.
On the other hand, Alfred, another reincarnated hero and former elite and head of a local government,
‘Why does a mob character, a villainous sorcerer, have multiple skills that powerful?　And he’s always acting like he’s trying to get in the way of the royal ending I’m trying to achieve!“
His frustration with the villain, Grace, was growing every day.
Am I getting a lot of hate from Alfred, the hero?
But, well, the fact that the heroes are the strongest is information that I had already received before the verification.
So, with my knowledge of the game and my divine skill set, I will continue to progress through this game world as I please!
associated_names: 最低最悪の悪役令息に転生しましたが、１０万分の１の神スキル構成を引き当てたので思うままに突き進みます！　〜何やら超絶パワハラ転生者の勇者から強いヘイトを買っている模様〜

91292.synopsis:
After clearing the infinite flow world, Bai Siqiao chose to be reborn in the plane where his missing lover lived to find him. Unfortunately, he didn’t choose the right shell, and he was reborn in the body of a poor little guy who was hated by people and dogs, and he was also tied to an evil god system. The other party said that as long as he absorbed the emotional value, he could become stronger and stronger until he became a god.
System: Help the bad guys escape, and we can get 3,000 emotional points!
Bai Siqiao threw the bad guy into the tr*sh can with one hand, and his emotional value instantly increased by 10,000.
System: The drunk boy met a s*umbag, and mocking him can absorb 5,000 emotional points!
Bai Siqiao helped him to ruin the s*umbag and introduced him to a tall, rich, and handsome man, and his emotional value instantly increased by 50,000.
System: These evil ghosts are here to recognize you as the boss. As the successor of the evil god, how can you not have younger brothers?
Bai Siqiao pushed open the bedroom door: “Dear, there are evil ghosts at home, you deal with it.”
The system crashed, is this okay???
Bai Siqiao: “Baby, listen to me, I will help you get rich and become a Buddha on the spot!”
….
After the Bai family’s eldest son, who was disliked by people and dogs, was rescued, he stopped teasing cats and dogs and also stopped fighting. He punishes evil and promotes good, protects classmates, helps poor students, fights gangsters bravely, rescues abducted children… Not afraid of danger or hardship, and eager to do any good thing. 
When the “Exorcist Team” found him, the youngest of the “Top Ten National Models of Bravery and Righteousness, Pioneer of Social Civilization in the New Era”, wearing a dazzling array of merits, he was giving a passionate speech: “I am a brick of socialism, and I will move wherever I am needed!”
associated_names: The system begged me to become a god!

91804.synopsis: Your Commander-in-Chief follows a protagonist who is transformed into a young female in a virtual reality game, navigating the challenges of their new identity and enhanced abilities.

93852.synopsis:
There exists an animal known as the most fearless creature on Earth.  
There exists an animal that even young leopards mimic to protect themselves.  
There exists an animal so short-tempered that when it loses control, it might even bite itself.  
There exists an animal whose life is either spent fighting or on the way to a fight.  
This animal has an endearing name: the honey badger. But people prefer its nickname: Buzz-Cut Bro!  
Don’t tell me who they are, don’t tell me how many there are. Just tell me the time and place! — Buzz-Cut Bro 
This is a fictional story about a protagonist reincarnated as a honey badger. Please enjoy, and no hate if it’s not to your taste!

95132.synopsis:
“Dragons experience fated love. There’s a destined partner determined by the world line, and they inevitably fall in love with that person.”
Siol, who devoted himself to alchemy at the royal research institute. He dies at the hands of a blue dragon, branded as the ‘Alchemist of Death’ due to the betrayal of his disciple and the king. Siol escapes from the dead homunculus body and returns to his original body, but somehow his original body has transformed into that of a child. Just then, he encounters the blue dragon Eoreugen who came to rescue him. Without a chance to explain his identity, Siol is moved to Eoreugen’s castle, where he is protected as part of the beast-human family and faces secrets he never knew before…
Siol’s world turns upside down in an instant. Will he be able to shed the stigma of being the ‘Alchemist of Death’ and take revenge on the king and his disciple?

95644.synopsis:
I saved an idol streamer. She’s a little… off.
The lone adventurer, Satou Makoto.
Known as “The God of Dungeon Capture,” he is a top-tier solo explorer who writes a low-profile blog about his exploits.
However, for some reason, his blog, detailing SSS-ranked dungeon captures, ends up gaining popularity on its own.
Before he knows it, his blog has attracted many readers, including one particularly energetic girl who keeps leaving enthusiastic comments.
Then one day, that girl, who turns out to be a famous idol streamer, falls into trouble while live-streaming from a dungeon.
Makoto intervenes to save her. However…
From that moment, his quiet solo life begins to change.
“By the way, what’s the next dungeon you’re going to clear?”
“Wow, your moves are so amazing, Makoto-san!”
“Uh… What did I get myself into?”
associated_names: ぼっち探索者は、SSS級ダンジョンをソロで攻略しているようです

95900.synopsis:
Chi Wang is good-looking, academically gifted, and highly ambitious, attending the prestigious H University with a promising future ahead. He has only one shortcoming—he’s broke. So broke, his pockets could practically sprout fingers sticking out.  
To make ends meet, he becomes the ultimate part-time job king, working tirelessly to carve out a bright path for himself.  
Meanwhile, Xie Siheng is the campus heartthrob of H University: tall, handsome, as cold as an iceberg, and rumored to come from a wealthy family. He’s expected to study abroad in the future, yet that doesn’t stop countless admirers—both male and female—from confessing their love.  
By all logic, such a star figure should have nothing to do with Chi Wang. But fate plays its tricks, and one accidental night brings them together.  
When Chi Wang wakes up the next morning, he’s bewildered. Glancing at himself and then at the silent Xie Siheng, he finally blurts out, “I don’t have to pay for the room, right?”  
Xie Siheng: “…”  
Xie Siheng: “No.”  
Chi Wang quickly rolls away, brushing it off without much concern. Life goes on—work, classes, and the occasional nod of acknowledgment when they pass each other on campus. Everything seems fine.  
Until a few months later, when Chi Wang’s stomach begins to bulge. Thinking it’s just indigestion from bad food, he visits the hospital with a friend’s encouragement, only to be hit with shocking news from the doctor:  
“You’re pregnant!”  
Chi Wang: “???”  
Huh?  
He’s a boy!  
A recheck confirms the same result: he’s pregnant.  
Chi Wang: “…”  
What???  
Reading Notes:  
1. Optimistic and cheerful Bottom x Cold and reserved yet secretly passionate Top.  
2. Fluffy and sweet with a focus on mpreg!  
3. Assumes a world where same-s*x marriage is normalized.

96924.synopsis:
“Our motto is safety and reliability… or at least it’s supposed to be!?”
Set against the backdrop of the galaxy, this space opera unfolds as a slice-of-life story!
Shaun Riot, a member of the Galactic Transporter Guild, works as a cargo and passenger transporter aboard his beloved ship, the White Cargo. While his ship is an older model and can’t achieve high speeds, Shaun takes pride in his safe and steady driving. He’s committed to maintaining a perfect safety record, sticking to stable speeds and avoiding accidents or violations.
However, this cautious approach has earned his ship the unfortunate nickname “Snail” due to its sluggish pace.
Even so, Shaun firmly believes that safety comes first, and he carries out his day-to-day tasks with a perfectly ordinary mindset. But no matter how much he tries to live a peaceful, uneventful life, trouble and challenges always seem to find their way to him!
“I’m just trying to live a completely ordinary life—what’s wrong with that!?”
associated_names: カタツムリの貨客船業務日誌

97692.synopsis:
What Fate Awaits the Villainous Duke Who, Fearing Condemnation, Works to Raise the Affection of the Heroines (Including His Daughter)?
One day, a man realizes that he has been reincarnated as the villainous duke (37) in a certain game.
If things continue as they are, he will follow the villain route and eventually be condemned by the main heroine, who is none other than his own daughter.
Using his knowledge of the game, the man begins taking action to avoid his own condemnation. However, for some reason, his daughter repeatedly lets glimpses of her “Ice Lady” side show whenever the opportunity arises…
In this world where the game scenario has been unstable from the very beginning, can the man survive as a duke? And can he save the world in place of the protagonist who is destined for a ruin route? Thus begin the days of battle for survival and affection raising for the villainous duke (37).
associated_names: I Was Reborn as a Villainous Duke (37) Who Gets Condemned by His Own Daughter — Even Though I Stopped Acting Like a Villain, For Some Reason My Daughter Is Becoming an “Ice Lady.”
Musume ni Danzai sareru Akuyaku Koushaku ni Tensei shitemashita: Akuyaku Muubu wo Yameta no ni Naze ka Musume ga “Koori no Reijou” ka suru Ken

娘に断罪される悪役公爵(37）に転生してました　～悪役ムーブをやめたのになぜか娘が『氷の令嬢』化する件～

98972.synopsis: Planets dying, gods falling. “Anomalies” and “Calamities” invade the human world. As a dark age descends, Shen Ye finds himself flung into this strange new reality. To his surprise, his power is to summon a door – a door leading to countless worlds, offering him a chance to adventure and train across the multiverse! Beyond the door, he encounters a mysterious skeleton with an unknown past…

99484.synopsis:
29 attempts to defeat the Corrupted God, and failure.
Just as he was about to start his 30th life, he finds himself reincarnated into the body of a character he’s never even heard of in all his previous lives.
What? This body belongs to an unfortunate genius with unparalleled talent?”

99996.synopsis:
“That time on the stairs, the one who pushed me… it was you, Do Gyeoul?”
No matter how hard I tried, I couldn’t succeed, let alone debut.
I always thought it was my fault.
[No matter how hard you tried, did the situation refuse to improve?
Oh dear, could that really have been your fault?] 
But the truth was different.
“Yeoreum, right now, you look really pathetic….”
[Due to an error, your  points have been transferred to someone else for 10 years.] 
All my frustrations and failures—it was because of you, Do Gyeoul.
The reason I couldn’t reach my cherished goal of becoming an actress was because of you.
I realized it the moment I died, when a status window appeared before my eyes.
And then, immediately after, as if it were a lie—
“…What is this?”
[♣From an unknown, nameless actress to a national star!♣
Let’s make your name known far and wide. Reborn as an actor who will go down in history.] 
I returned to when I was twenty years old.
A time when I could change everything.
**
‘I mustn’t be overshadowed by Do Gyeoul’s connections this time.’
“Hello, I’m Han Yeoreum, here for today’s model audition.”
So I went to find someone who would become the greatest photographer in Korea’s future,
“Then, I’ll start my acting now.”
And I auditioned for the lead role in the drama destined to make waves.
I took back everything she had stolen from me, one by one.
And when I did—
-At the pre-edit screening, Jegal Rok… I heard he’s planning to attend.
The biggest figures in the entertainment industry began to focus on me.
**
“But, Yeoreum.”
My peer and, before my regression, a triple-million-hit actor.
Myeong Je-ha smiled faintly with his handsome face.
“It’s strange… This is your first play, but you act like you’ve memorized all the lines….”
Ding—!
[Name: Myeong Je-ha] 
Level: An eternally breathing star
At that moment, I realized.
“I’ll listen to the lie you’ve prepared next time.”
The man in front of me was also a regressor.

100252.synopsis: On the day the cage is broken, the imprisoned bird can finally soar across the sky. The taste of freedom is wonderful, but Hyuga Makoto wants to create a cage for the world.

103068.synopsis:
Plowing the land, feeding pigs, and milking cows, the farming life of a top gynaecologist from the 21st century began just like that.
The little ger of the Zhang family is five months pregnant, so he should pay attention to nutrition;
The one of the Liu family has had severe morning sickness recently, so he went to see him after drying the vegetables;
The one of the Chen family might be twins, and they will be born in a few days;
The milk supply has been insufficient recently, so I have to think about buying another cow…
Wiping the sweat off his face, the man took a breath, and walked towards the gate of the yard excitedly,
A little baby came up with a clatter, and hugged the man’s thigh…
“Daddy, daddy! Father said you are not allowed to go out recently!”
“Who are you calling Daddy! I am Father! Father! Do you know? Call me and listen!”
“Fath… Second Father…”
“…”
“Dad… Second Father, are you feeling uncomfortable? Do you want to vomit? Father! Father!
Second Father wants to vomit again! Am I going to have a younger brother!”
Damn it! Why did contraception fail again? Why is infertility so difficult…

103324.synopsis:
As a regressor, I figured I’d just throw this round away and go wild since I’d be returning anyway.
But something feels off.

103580.synopsis:
Ever since an incident three years ago, art school graduate Shen Mo hasn’t been able to paint with his right hand. He’s currently working a desk job in a company owned by the Ji family, one of the wealthiest families in the city. Unbeknownst to his coworkers, however, he has a far more important role: the fake lover of the Ji family’s young CEO, Ji Mingxuan.
Ever the perfectionist, Ji Mingxuan makes Shen Mo put on the full act, both in public and in the bedroom. Their fake relationship continues this way, until Ji Mingxuan’s sister returns from abroad with her boyfriend—Shen Mo’s ex.
Once the four are reunited, the nightmares that Shen Mo has tried so desperately to escape catch up to him at last. As the lovers’ acting becomes more and more real, Shen Mo begins to learn about the things that Ji Mingxuan is keeping from him, as well as the truth of what really happened three years ago.
Only one question left:
What will become of a love founded on pretense?
associated_names: Closer Than Strangers, Farther Than Lovers

105884.synopsis:
As the Demon Emperor, Yu Mu single-handedly confronted the Child of Destiny, all to save a world that did not believe in him. In the end, he died heartbroken by the sword of the one he loved most. 
Reborn, this time, he will live for himself and for those who love him. He will show this world that, without any emotional ties, the Child of Destiny is nothing but a plaything, and the peak of the world is just a fleeting cloud!
associated_names: 重生魔帝，我得离他们远一点

107676.synopsis:
I killed him. I did.
The countless stains of blood on his hands, the truth of who he was—after hearing it, I couldn’t bring myself to look into his eyes anymore. I was afraid he’d see it. The way my heart pounded, ready to burst, against the scars carved into his gaze.
“When does this end?”
A fake bride. A fake marriage. Years spent drowning in tears, bound to a ledger soaked in ink and a knife stained with blood. Instead of resisting, I chose to wrap my fingers around the back of his neck, tracing the quiet pulse beneath my touch.
“That…”
His hand again. This time, under my skirt. A burning palm sliding up my ice-cold thigh.
“Not now.”
His breath brushes against my skin. Once again, I let myself be abandoned to his heavy hands, the weight of them forcing my thighs apart as I pretend to be his woman.
“Should I ask again tomorrow?”
Bastard. The word lingers on my lips, but I swallow it down. Because only in moments like this does he see me as a person—only when his hands roam my skin, when his lips claim mine.  Only when my body heats up. Only when he pushes me to the edge of that cliff.
Brutally pitiful. Desperately wretched. And, tragically… romantic.

108188.synopsis:
“Don’t fall in love. It will only bring you misery.”
Cordelia Marguerite, a descendant of a mermaid betrayed by love, endured a miserable upbringing. After losing her mother at a young age, she was mistreated by her relatives and grew up with only one hope: to survive until adulthood, marry her wealthy fiancé, and escape her family.
But everything unravelled when the hereditary illness passed down from her mother finally manifested. Her engagement was called off, and though she now faced a terminal diagnosis, Cordelia was determined not to end her life in sorrow. She set out on a journey, a final rebellion before the end.
However, her first adventure takes a sharp turn when the cruise ship she boards is hijacked by pirates. At the brink of danger, she is rescued by none other than Noah Tudor, the empire’s celebrated war hero and a ruthless financier.
“Thank you… You saved my life.”
“I doubt your life is all you owe me.”
Noah, the infamous head of the powerful Raven Bank, demands repayment of a massive debt left by Cordelia’s father. Now terminally ill and bankrupt, Cordelia is forced to make a desperate deal to buy just one more year of freedom.
“So, you’re trying to seduce me now because you’re broke?”
“I-I wasn’t trying to seduce–”
“Then you should let me buy you. What kind of gentleman refuses a lady who’s this eager to sell everything she has?”
Despite his sharp tongue and cold demeanour, Noah is endlessly kind and dazzling. To someone like Cordelia, who spent her life like a thirsty fish in a dried-up pond, he crashes into her world like the vast, overwhelming sea.
Love and affection are the roots of all unhappiness. But can Cordelia truly go to her grave without ever falling in love with him?
A Harlequin-style romance between a frail yet feisty, debt-ridden mermaid girl and Noah Tudor, the irrationally chivalrous creditor who slowly breaks down her walls.

112284.synopsis:
Gu Shunhua realized she was a side character in a retro-era novel just as she was buying a roasted sweet potato in Dashilan Alley. The familiar Beijing accent rang in her ears: “Are you buying it or not?” She dropped the sweet potato and bolted straight for the train station.
According to the novel’s plot, she would soon divorce her husband temporarily just to return to the city. But at the moment of divorce, her cousin Chen Lu would seize the chance to marry her ex-husband, bear him children, and bask in his rise to success—while her own twins would end up imprisoned for embezzling company funds.
The book’s tone, full of superiority thinly veiled as pity, reads: ”Gu Shunhua wasn’t truly evil—just a little petty, a little shortsighted, the typical selfishness of a small-minded woman. Traumatized by her time in the countryside, she resorted to desperate measures just to return to the city… and lost a perfectly good marriage in the process.”
Gu Shunhua: To hell with that!
She charged back to the countryside, scooped her twins into her arms, and declared, ”Wherever Mama goes, you go too. The three of us will never be separated again!”
Ren Jingnian, fiddling with the radio, looked up: “Why are you back already?” Staring at the man who would one day dote on the novel’s heroine while ignoring his own children, Gu Shunhua straightened her back and said, ”You wish I’d never come back? Want to mistreat my son and daughter?”
Ren Jingnian: “…?” Gu Shunhua: “Fine, let’s divorce. I get the kids—you get the donkey.”
Ren Jingnian: … What did I even do wrong?
Meanwhile, Chen Lu—who admired her superior so much she wrote an entire romance novel inspired by him—also found herself transported into the book.  Now, with the tide of Reform and Opening just beginning, the dashing young tycoon she modeled her hero after may be married, but he’s still full of promise… She thinks: This is my chance!
Only… 
Why haven’t they divorced yet? 
Why not yet? 
Why… Why?!
associated_names: The Courtyard Compound Wife in the Seventies

114076.synopsis:
Because Ki Sihyeon is the only adult I don’t have to tiptoe around. I don’t have to be careful with him. He treats me like a kid—annoying, but he’s not afraid of me. He’s not weak.
Seonwoo, a mental-type S-Class Esper raised under strict surveillance and control at the Center, was trained to suppress all emotion. Even when other Espers hurled insults or lashed out violently, he never once retaliated. He simply followed orders.
But in front of Ki Sihyeon, a fellow S-Class Esper and his teammate—the only one who ever treated him like a person—keeping his emotions in check became a challenge. After all, he’d been in love with him for a long time.
Yet Ki Sihyeon already had someone. A sweet, kind guide named Yoo Sejin. Because of that, Seonwoo never even considered confessing.
Then one day, Sejin ends up in a vegetative state after trying to save Seonwoo. Wracked with guilt, Seonwoo braces for Sihyeon’s anger…
But instead, Sihyeon says something cryptic.
“Then you’ll have to take Sejin’s place, kid.”

114588.synopsis:
On January 1, 202X, dungeons appeared all over the world.
These dungeons were both a new resource and a disaster, as monsters overflowed from them. To combat this, a new profession called “explorer” was born, who uses skills and items to defeat monsters… Meanwhile, the protagonist, who lived in the location where the dungeon appeared, wakes up in a labyrinth in the morning.
This is the story of a protagonist who, hit by such misfortune, becomes stronger and survives by using his skills and magic.
associated_names: 朝起きたらダンジョンにいたんだが　～異世界転移？いいえここは現実世界です～

117660.synopsis:
A poor opera singer born out of wedlock, Maylily Aile. A noble man who extends a hand of patronage to her, Hugh Skaard, Count of Everscourt.
Though she knows their relationship will never be equal, Maylily cannot help but fall in love with Hugh. For he was the one who gifted the most radiant spring to her desolate life.
And just when she fully accepts Hugh, Maylily comes face-to-face with the cold truth lurking behind their relationship…
***
“I don’t like you anymore, Count.”
“Then start liking me again. Considering what we’ve become, it’ll be less miserable for you that way.”

118428.synopsis:
“So many people are following you. Even the citizens praise you as the hero, not me.”
I thought I was as good as dead after being stabbed by the sword of the friend I trusted most.
But when I opened my eyes, I found myself…
{Welcome to Earth, Hero!}
“Never seen your friend before—do they happen to belong to any agency?”
To return to my original world, I must grow stronger by becoming an idol.
But not just any idol—I’m told I must become a Hunter Idol.

120476.synopsis:
After awakening the trait “Oath of the Dragon (EX),” I opened my eyes in a strange cave.
“Where am I?”
Then I realized—
Oh no! 
This is a dragon’s lair?!

126620.synopsis:
Dai Lin became a surgeon at an eerie hospital.
Here, what they treat aren’t diseases, but all manner of terrifying and cryptic curses! The hospital is divided into departments such as the Department of Resentful Spirits, the Department of Vicious Ghosts, the Department of Malevolent Ghosts, the Department of Fierce Spirits, and the mysterious Department of Demons…
The eerie hospital, however, has a set of inexplicable rules:
First, believe that this hospital is named Hospital 444, not Hospital 666.
Second, between midnight and 4 a.m., doctors and nurses must never enter the outpatient area.
Third, if you experience a severe pain in your forehead and an inverted cross appears, immediately seek treatment at the hospital’s Department of Demons.
Fourth, all doctors in the hospital wear white masks. If you see doctors wearing red masks, ignore them. Do not let them realize that you can see them.
Fifth…
Meanwhile, Dai Lin has obtained a wondrous Cursed Item: a pair of Demon’s Eyes. His left eye can detect, sense, and attack, while his right eye can imprison, seal, and even devour and absorb.
And the source of all the horror in this hospital… is the Dean, who has never been seen by anyone.

127132.synopsis:
【Short Drama: “I Became a Stepmom in the 1980s”】
1980s, stepmother, raising kids, slice-of-life, marriage before love
Upon waking up, Si Nian found herself transmigrated as the fake heiress in a period novel—kicked back to the countryside to marry a divorced man in place of the real heiress, with a bunch of kids to raise.
To make matters worse, she encountered the novel’s heroine: the real heiress who had been reborn.
In her past life, Lin Sisi was forced by her family to marry an older divorced man. Cold and unfeeling, he never cared for her. Meanwhile, Si Nian—the impostor who stole her privileged life—married a doting military officer and lived in bliss.
Reborn and vengeful, Lin Sisi swore to steal Si Nian’s officer husband and make her suffer the same misery.
But things didn’t go as planned for the real heiress.
Instead, Si Nian stood by the older man as they amassed a fortune, living gloriously while their children grew into remarkable adults.
When brought before the older man, Si Nian wasn’t fazed:
This was the madman who’d rather raise another man’s children than have his own.
While others avoided him, her eyes sparkled: “First, motherhood is sacred. Second, I’ll be the best stepmom.”
Years later, the real heiress struggled—dealing with her officer husband’s illegitimate children and fighting over assets—but consoled herself: “At least I’m better off than Si Nian, who has no kids of her own, plays nanny to another’s, and lives like a servant.”
Until one day, the feared tycoon—cold and ruthless to all—gently helped his pregnant wife from their car, cradling her with adoration.
Si Nian tugged his hair angrily: “You swore we’d never have kids!”
The man kissed her hand tenderly: “My love, I was wrong. Let’s have more.”
associated_names: 八零漂亮后妈，嫁个厂长养崽崽

129948.synopsis:
Yuan Ying’s boyfriend, who had been missing for three years, came back.
“So what you mean is… your real identity is a dragon? And you left without saying goodbye because you had to return to the Dragon Clan, fight with your siblings for billions in inheritance, and then give it all to me?”
“Yes.”
Yuan Ying stretched out her hand: “Where’s the billions?”
 Zhu Feng: “I didn’t bring it.”
 Yuan Ying: “Then what did you come back for?”
 Zhu Feng calmly pulled down his zipper: “My restless period has come. I came back to have little dragons with you.”
Yuan Ying smiled, and called the police.
Reading Tips:
He really is a dragon.
He really does have billions in inheritance.
After dragons reach maturity, their non-dragon partners’ bodies also undergo certain changes.
